inputs.text: [excited] Kry… oh… loh… foh… saurus. [curious] "Cryo," in Greek, means ice, cold. [playful] "Lopho" means a crest. And "saurus" means lizard.
[confident] The frozen lizard, turned into an ice cube.

[chuckles] Not quite — the ice is just in its name. [amazed] The ice-crested lizard. It lived in Antarctica, one hundred ninety million years ago. [confident] But back then, Antarctica was covered in forests, warm and green.
[playful] None at all. [amazed] Trees, plants, and plenty of plant-eaters to hunt, way down at the bottom of the world.
